name: io.drint/dripod
title: Dripod
description: Put a print-on-demand design on 3D mockups of T-shirts, hoodies, mugs, hats and phone cases as PNG.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The print-on-demand products Dripod can put a design on (T-shirts, hoodies, mugs, tumblers, hats, totes, phone cases, pillows, socks…), each with its blank colours and its page on drint.io. Narrow it by shelf or by a word in the name.

search.description: Only products whose name has this word, like "hoodie" or "mug".

tools.name: pod_mockup
tools.description: Put a print-on-demand design on a product mockup in one blank colour and get a PNG. The design is the product's whole print area (a shirt's front, a mug's side, a case's back). Give the design as design_url (a public https link) or design_base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 10 MB; a transparent PNG works best). Call it once per product and colour.

colour.description: One of the product's colours (list_products), like "Black". Leave it out for its first.

design_url.description: A public https link to the design (PNG, JPEG or WebP).

design_base64.description: The design itself, base64 (a data: URL is fine).

background.description: "transparent" for a cut-out PNG, or a colour like "#ffffff". Leave it out for a soft studio grey.

size.description: The square PNG's side in pixels (default 1024).
